features.title: Mission Control live runtime status layer
features.summary: Dashboard now reports real runtime state (services, broker health, policy/manifest load, audit/proof paths, panic, approvals, Hermes connectivity) with explicit PASS/WARN/FAIL badges.

features.title: Client adapter preflight for external agent runtimes
features.summary: Adds a non-privileged preflight proving client runtimes can reach and use the SlimyOS broker safely, while confirming dangerous/raw-shell paths remain blocked or gated.

features.title: SlimyOS MCP stdio bridge
features.summary: Introduces a minimal local MCP server that exposes tool discovery and tool calls through slimy-toold while preserving policy outcomes (allowed/blocked/approval_required) and failing closed when broker is unavailable.

features.title: MCP doctor dry-run and healthline
features.summary: Adds operator-facing MCP doctor and one-line healthline checks that produce proof artifacts, detect client wiring readiness, and validate blocked/gated policy evidence without mutating user config by default.

features.title: Safe MCP client config apply and rollback
features.summary: Adds safe client config installer with dry-run, --apply (with timestamped backup and JSON validation), --rollback, --status, and --write-snippets modes. Supported: Claude Desktop (merge mcpServers). Unsupported clients stay MANUAL_REQUIRED, not FAIL. Real Claude Desktop install verified.

features.title: Claude Desktop MCP post-install verification
features.summary: Post-install verifier that reads real Claude Desktop config, confirms SlimyOS entry, validates launcher, runs live MCP checks (initialize, tools/list, safe/blocked/gated calls), checks broker health, redacts secrets, and generates proof artifacts. Read-only, no mutation.
